title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：preference　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 preference 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the trader ① stated the preference that no partner in the market would have measured, and he said the stating was the whole of the week. The ② preference, meaning the choice itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed unmeasured in the book; a preference, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ preference in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ preference at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A preference, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the trader said the measuring is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the preference was the whole of the matter, meaning the taste and not the choice. The ⑥ preference, meaning the taste and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; preference, he said, is either something you state or the only word that means both a choice and a taste. He said the taste is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ preference had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ preference of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of measuring; preference, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ preference I remember is the choice measured in the list, which closed in 1978 and is still measured as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ preference, my mother said in 1980, is the only choice that improves by being measured; every preference, she said, is a taste that has agreed to look like a choice. She said the taste was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 偏爱；偏好（指集市里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 偏爱；偏好（指那种偏爱本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：state the preference 说明这一种偏爱
D. n. 偏爱；偏好（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 偏爱之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的偏爱之事）
F. n. 偏爱；偏好（指货单里写到、被测量的那一种）
G. n. 偏爱、口味（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 口味（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: stated the preference that no partner in the market would have measured
The preference, meaning the choice itself and not the basket
the preference at the far stall
the preference was the whole of the matter
the preference had become a line in a list
The preference of the whole thing
A preference, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: state the preference 意为“说明这一种偏爱”，1971 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯测量的一种偏爱做了一遍。
preference 意为“偏爱；偏好”，指那种偏爱本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被测量。
preference 意为“偏爱；偏好”，指集市里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
preference 意为“偏爱；偏好”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
preference 意为“偏爱、口味”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种口味就是那件事的全部。
preference 意为“口味”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种偏爱，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
preference 意为“偏爱；偏好”，指货单里写到、被测量的那一种，到 1976 年这一种成了货单里的一行。
preference 意为“偏爱之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的偏爱之事是一处集市和三个星期的测量。
preference 意为“偏爱；偏好”，我记得的是货单里测量过的那一种，1978 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一种。
preference 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，偏爱是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的偏爱。
